auditor.held_by: the owner, given to an auditor out of band; never served by the API or committed
auditor.contains: the payee viewing key (UFVK) and the opening (amount in zatoshi and salt)
auditor.how: the auditor imports the UFVK into their own zcash-devtool view-only wallet (init-fvk, sync, enhance, list-tx), reads the amount and the salt from the encrypted memo, then checks the opening against the commitment on chain with POST /api/mistbank/verify or by hashing it locally
auditor.rotated: the first payout key was public until 2026-10-28; that payee account is retired and future payouts use a fresh payee wallet
